model.effect: Changes to portfolio payment methods apply to all linked accounts

answers.doesANewAdvertiserAutomaticallyGetTheCar: Only if TikTok links/selects the same Payment Portfolio and payment setup is confirmed; creation alone is not sufficient.
answers.canAnExistingCardBeUsedWithoutReentering: Yes when the card already belongs to the selected Portfolio and TikTok allows the account to link it; additional verification can still be required.
answers.whatIfNoCardExists: The user must use the official Add payment method flow. The extension must not collect raw card details.
answers.whatIfANewBusinessCenterUsesAnotherPortf: It does not inherit payment methods from the old Portfolio.
answers.whereToManageBcOwnedAccount: Business Center Finance / Payment management; Ads Manager may show a read-only notice that payment methods are managed in the Portfolio.

livePaymentSetup.result: Payment setup section disappeared after Confirm; Ads Manager shows Payment Portfolio Advanced

adsManagerObservation.paymentMethodsMessage: Payment methods are managed in the Payment Portfolio, and any changes apply to all linked accounts.
adsManagerObservation.automaticPaymentScheduleObserved: Nov 1, 2026 or when ad spending reaches 5.00 EUR

automationContract.mutation: Click the enabled Confirm in the Payment setup section only after an explicit user click in the extension.
stopConditions: No existing Portfolio ID is visible
BC/advertiser IDs do not match the creation job
TikTok shows an error, CAPTCHA, identity or payment verification
